Sporta icon set

48 hand-drawn glyphs on one 24 grid: round caps and joins, one stroke in screen pixels (1.5px up to a 20px box, 1.75px from 21px, as on the live shop), a 2.5 corner radius, and a short speed dash on the things that move. Each card shows the glyph at 16, 20 and 24px exactly as the shop paints it (a mask in currentColor), then the source drawing at 48px. Glyphs marked "mirrors in RTL" are flipped in the right-to-left panels.

Delivery within 24 hoursCard payment14-day returnsSecure checkoutShop now
